character_tex: Integrable characters of affine $SU(2)_k$ at $z=1$, labelled by $l = 2j = 0,\dots,k$: $\chi_l(\tau) = \frac{q^{h_l - c/24}}{\prod_{n\ge1}(1-q^n)^3}\sum_{m\in\mathbb{Z}} \big(l+1+2(k+2)m\big)\, q^{(k+2)m^2 + (l+1)m}$, $h_l = \frac{l(l+2)}{4(k+2)}$, $c = \frac{3k}{k+2}$; computed from the graded Weyl-Kac formula and summed over the $J^3_0$ grading.
description: $D_{10}$ invariant of $SU(2)_{16}$ (Cappelli-Itzykson-Zuber), block-diagonal (the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ simple-current extension by $\chi_{16}$); equivalently the orbifold of the diagonal theory by the $\mathbb{Z}_2$ centre, which keeps the untwisted states with even $l$ and adds the twisted-sector states $\chi_l\overline{\chi_{16-l}}$ with $l$ even. Blocks are $SU(2)_{16}$ characters and $Z$ gives their multiplicities.
